q: How much does a photo booth rental cost in NYC?
a: Pricing depends on which booth you choose, how many hours you need, and where your venue is. Every quote is built for your specific event rather than pulled off a rate card, so the fastest way to a real number is the quote form — it takes about 30 seconds. Additional hours beyond your booked time are $125 per hour.

q: Is an attendant included with the photo booth rental?
a: Yes. A trained attendant runs every booth for the full length of your rental — setting up, keeping the prop table organized, helping guests, and packing down afterward. You never have to assign someone from your own team to look after the booth.

q: How much space does the booth need?
a: Optimal setup is 10ft x 10ft, which leaves room for the backdrop, prop table and a red carpet. We can compress into a smaller footprint when a venue is tight — the minimum is 8ft x 8ft with 7.5ft of ceiling clearance. We also need a standard 110V, 5-amp, 3-prong outlet within 15 feet of the booth.

About 20 minutes from the moment we walk in until we are taking the first picture. We arrive a full hour before your scheduled start time so everything is tested and ready. If you need us on site earlier than that, idle time is $55 per hour.

q: Do you carry insurance and can you provide a COI for my venue?
a: Yes. We carry a $2 million insurance policy. If your venue needs a certificate of insurance naming them as additionally insured, reply to your booking confirmation with their contact email and we will send it over.

q: How far in advance should I book a photo booth?
a: As soon as your date is confirmed. Peak season and weekend dates go first, so booking early is how you secure yours. We will always try to accommodate last-minute requests when we have availability.

q: Can we customize the photo template with our logo or event name?
a: Yes. Print templates are custom-designed for your event — names, date, colors, a monogram, or a company logo for brand activations. Booths can also be fully wrapped and branded, with a custom start screen and a branded online gallery.
